Commit bb01606926edeec828cc123e86a4a300bdc96c9b
poseTracking.upstream.js is the original src/poseTracking.js, retained for lineage.
limb-detectors.js adapts its GPU Pose Full configuration and task creation to
Prisma's worker. It adds OffscreenCanvas, resource cleanup and a CPU/Lite fallback.
HandLandmarker is retained instead of the plugin's GestureRecognizer because this
feature uses coordinates rather than classified gestures. No .tox component is
claimed to run in Prisma. The 1 Euro filter comes from Casiez's original repository.
